harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.note: OpenCode reads any OpenAI-compatible address through the @ai-sdk/openai-compatible package, and an address that speaks the Responses API through @ai-sdk/openai.

harnesses.name: Pi
harnesses.note: The apiKey field can name an environment variable as $NAME.

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.note: Codex speaks the Responses API only: responses is the one supported wire API of a custom provider. Ollama and LM Studio are built in and start with --oss.

harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.note: Claude Code sends Anthropic Messages requests to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. Anthropic says it does not support routing Claude Code to models other than Claude through any gateway, so some features may not work with another model.

data_policy.note: Abuse monitoring logs are kept for up to 30 days by default. Zero data retention is offered to approved organizations.

observed_output_limits.note: Baltor's own provider client declares an output limit for gpt-6-astra (128,000 tokens, 2026-09-04).

structured_output.note: JSON schema output with strict mode.

apis.note: Anthropic describes this compatibility layer as a way to test the Claude API with the OpenAI SDK.

data_policy.note: API inputs and outputs are deleted within 30 days by default, with the exceptions the page lists, such as a zero data retention agreement.

auth.header: x-goog-api-key, or Authorization: Bearer on the OpenAI-compatible address

data_policy.note: Content sent under the unpaid quota may be used to improve Google products. Paid use follows the paid services terms on the same page.
Mistral documents which endpoints are eligible for zero data retention and how to request it.

observed_output_limits.note: Baltor's own provider client declares an output limit for mistral-large-latest (16,384 tokens, 2026-09-01), mistral-medium-latest (8,192 tokens, 2026-09-01), mistral-small-latest (8,192 tokens, 2026-09-01).

data_policy.note: Inference requests are not retained by default. Batch files are kept for 30 days unless deleted earlier.

structured_output.note: JSON schema output with strict mode on the models the page lists.

data_policy.note: The privacy policy says Cerebras does not retain the inputs and outputs of its inference services, as its section 6 describes.
Together documents what it stores from inputs and outputs, and offers zero data retention.
Fireworks documents its zero data retention terms on this page.
Inputs and outputs are held in memory only while a request runs, with the exceptions the page lists for some partner models.
OpenRouter does not store prompts or responses unless you opt in. The provider that serves a request has its own policy.

structured_output.note: Available on the models whose supported parameters include structured outputs.

tool_calling.note: Available on the models whose supported parameters include tools.

apis.note: The cloud address answers stateless Responses requests only.
The cloud address needs Authorization: Bearer and does not accept x-api-key alone.

data_policy.note: Content sent to cloud models is processed to answer the request and is not stored beyond it.

observed_output_limits.note: Baltor's own provider client declares an output limit for deepseek-v4-flash:0731 (65,536 tokens, 2026-08-25), deepseek-v4-pro:0813 (65,536 tokens, 2026-08-31), deepseek-v4.1-flash (393,216 tokens, 2026-09-14), gemma4:31b (262,144 tokens, 2026-09-06), glm-5.1 (131,072 tokens, 2026-09-14), glm-5.2 (131,072 tokens, 2026-09-14), glm-5.3 (1,048,576 tokens, 2026-09-14), glm-5.3-flash (1,048,576 tokens, 2026-08-31), gpt-oss:120b (131,072 tokens, 2026-09-14), gpt-oss:20b (131,072 tokens, 2026-09-06), kimi-k2.6 (262,144 tokens, 2026-09-14), kimi-k2.7-code (262,144 tokens, 2026-09-14) and more.

rate_limits.note: Usage is limited by the plan; the account's usage page shows it.
